sources.title: cmasus/vocalis-models · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Kokoro models in ONNX format for Vocalis ONNX conversions of existing Kokoro text-to-speech models, used by the Vocalis app. No new training was done here: the speech comes from the original authors' weights. All output from these models is AI-generated speech and should be labeled as such when shared.
